{{BossList|Default}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Rotting Minigun}}''' - Fires lasers from its minigun, stunning towers for a long period of time. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Mechanical Rot''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared during the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Legacy Hidden Wave]], and therefore [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. Currently, it can only appear in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. The '''Mechanical Rot''' was considered a major boss. This enemy had the third highest health out of all the enemies in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]], with the [[Frost Hero (Frost Invasion)|Frost Hero]] being the second with 80,000 health and the [[Creator]] being the first with 600,000 health. It can attack towers with its ''Rotting Minigun'', stunning towers that it hits for a long period of time. The only redeeming thing about the '''Mechanical Rot''' is that it walked very slowly, even slower than the [[Creator]]. ==Appearance== The '''Mechanical Rot''' boasts the same texture and design scheme as [[Jack O' Bot]], but some of the colors are a bit darker, including the pumpkin head. The '''Mechanical Rot''' is armed with a laser machine gun and an arm cannon. It has a black pumpkin head, pumpkins on its shoulders and a fleshed-out torso, but everything else appears to be mechanical. It has a skull below its torso, and a metal pad on its chest. It is extremely tall due to its mechanical legs. It appears to be a rotting version of [[Jack O' Bot]], which tied into the '''Mechanical Rot''' name. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] is listed instead. *As with most [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] enemies, high DPS towers, such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] and [[Turret]], are recommended. **The [[Commander]] is essential to boost the firerate of towers. *Try to kill the '''Mechanical Rot''' as quickly as possible, as it can stun large swathes of towers, allowing fast [[enemies]], like the [[Bug]], or the [[Creator]] to walk past. **Its very slow speed allows it to be overtaken by most enemies, meaning that when the [[Creator]] comes out, the '''Mechanical Rot''' becomes incredibly hard to kill. *The [[Freezer]], [[Sledger]] and [[Frost Blaster]] cannot freeze the '''Mechanical Rot''' due to its large size and [[Freeze Immunity]]. **The [[Toxic Gunner]] cannot slow this down because of its poison immunity. **The [[Electroshocker]] can only slow down the '''Mechanical Rot''' instead of stunning it. Additionally, it can only slow it down for a very short period of time due to its large size. *If you have a [[Medic]] that is not stunned, its ability can be used to cleanse your towers if they are stunned from the ''Rotting Minigun''. *As with most other enemies in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]], the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability is essential in defeating this enemy. *While the [[Pyromancer]] cannot burn the '''Mechanical Rot''', it can still deal non-burn damage to it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animation}} LegacyMechanicalRotMinigun.gif|''Rotting Minigun'' animation (25 November 2019 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyMechanicalRot.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (11 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} MechanicalRotIconIG.png|'''Mechanical Rot''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The head of the '''Mechanical Rot''' is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|17450053|Sinister-P Sinister P.}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. **The pumpkin shoulders of the '''Mechanical Rot''' are re-textured versions of the {{RLinkC|16437015|Happy Jack-o'-Lantern}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The '''Mechanical Rot''' may be a reincarnation or rebuilt version of [[Jack O' Bot]], hence its name. *The '''Mechanical Rot''' may be a reference to the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Expired Jack|Expired Jack]] from [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Wave 0000000|Wave 0000000]] in ''Tower Battles''. ==Update History== *'''25 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.3|Release v1.3.0]] **'''Mechanical Rot''' added. *'''29 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.4|Release v1.4.0]] **Health increased from 50,000 to 75,000. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **{{Bug}} Bullets no longer stun towers. *'''4 July 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.4|Overhaul v1.4.0]] **'''Mechanical Rot''' can no longer be slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]]. *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]] **'''Mechanical Rot''' removed. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0|v1.53.3b]] **'''Mechanical Rot''' no longer appears in the legacy [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]], as it has been removed. *'''11 October 2025''' - [[v1.76.0|v1.76.4a]] **'''Mechanical Rot''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Mechanical Rot (Nil Zone)|Mechanical Rot]]'s from [[Nil Zone]] [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. **{{Bug}} '''Mechanical Rot''' breaks when targeting towers, causing it to get stuck. {{HiddenWave|[[Jaxe (Nightmare Carnival)|Jaxe]]|Mechanical Rot|[[Creator]]}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:Mechanical Rot}}
